To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have identified the peptidom of human β-caseins digested in vitro in a neonate by MALDI-TOF MS/MS.
we have found that the bioactive peptide precursor is the key factor in the bioactive peptide production of human β-caseins.
the bioactive peptide precursor of human milk β-casein might be digested into biologic active peptide in neonatal digestive tract.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the peptidomic analysis of human milk β-casein in neonatal digestive model.
the identification of bioactive peptides in human β-casein in vitro neonatal digestive model.

the peptidomics of human milk β-casein in vitro neonatal digestion model, which is of great importance for understanding the bioactive peptides in the human milk and the bioactive peptides generated in the digestive tract.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the bioactive peptide precursor of human β-caseins might be further digests into bioactive peptides in neonate.
human milk β-casein can generate a large variety of peptides in vitro neonatal digestive model, and most of these peptides have bioactivity.

the peptides generated from human milk β-casein in vitro neonatal digestive model are mainly composed of ACE inhibitory peptide precusors, antioxidant peptide precusors and immune active peptide precursor, which might be further digests into biologically active ACE inhibitory peptides, antioxidant peptides and immune active peptides.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
human β-casein is a good source of bioactive peptides.
human milk β-casein could provide the precursors of bioactive peptides to the neonate.
the bioactive peptides of human milk β-casein in neonate were mainly generated by the digestion of the precursor peptides.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the human milk β-casein can be further digested in vitro to generate bioactive peptides.
MALDI-TOF-TOF is a powerful tool for peptidome analysis of β-casein.
the bioactive peptide precursor of human milk β-casein can be further digested by neonate digestive enzyme into bioactive peptides.
